incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT created — Dedicated EU GPU pool (svc:dedicated-eu-rt) experiencing elevated 5xx rates affecting enterprise customers. PagerDuty routed to #incidents. Root ts=1789012345

sara (oncall): I'm on it — seeing the spike on 5xxs starting ~09:12 UTC. Pulling up logs and metrics now.

mike-sre: logs show repeated `kv-cache miss` + `cache-service` timeouts from 09:11->09:13. Correlates with redis-cluster failover events.

ryan-eng: confirming — redis pod flapped in eu-west-1a at 09:10. Some backend handlers degrade to 500 on cache key miss for long-context models.

sara (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) restart cache-service replica `cache-01` in eu-west-1a; (2) enable fallback routing to model-variant `redwood-small-qual` for affected routes; (3) open customer comms. Executing step 1 now.

mike-sre: restarted `cache-01` — `kubectl rollout restart deploy/cache-service -n prod --field-selector metadata.name=cache-01`. Watching errors.

status-bot: Status page draft updated to "Investigating — Elevated 5xx errors in Dedicated EU cluster" (https://status.redwoodai.example/incidents/1789012345).

emily-cs: Affected enterprise customers observed in telemetry: NovaGrid, AlderBio, Meridian Autos. Preparing tailored notices. Need routing/contact lists — @jordan-ps can you confirm?

jordan-ps: Confirming contacts: NovaGrid SE = claire-nova (claire@novagrid.example), SOC = soc-novagrid@novagrid.example, phone +1-555-0101. AlderBio contact = marc.a@alderbio.example, sec alias sec-alderbio@alderbio.example. Meridian exec = laura.m@meridian-auto.example. Also flagging legal for wording: @diane-legal.

diane-legal: Can we avoid ETA promises? Use: "We are investigating and mitigating. We will provide updates every 20 minutes." Also do not say "service restored" until we have full verification.

emily-cs: Draft customer messages (short, tailored):

- NovaGrid (high-touch): "Hello Claire — We're investigating elevated 5xx errors for your Dedicated EU deployment. Engineers are routing traffic to a fallback model and performing cache restarts to reduce errors. You may see intermittent failures for long-context requests. We will update in 20 minutes or sooner. For urgent escalation call +1-555-0101 or respond here. — Emily, Customer Ops"

- AlderBio (security-sensitive): "Hi Marc — We detected increased 5xx responses on your EU dedicated cluster which may affect throughput for some requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating; no evidence of data leakage. We'll send a security update within 60 minutes. For immediate concerns please use sec-alderbio@alderbio.example. — Emily, Customer Ops"

- Meridian Autos (exec notice): "Laura — We're investigating a service degradation affecting the EU dedicated environment that may cause increased errors for a subset of requests. Engineers have applied traffic routing mitigations; we will confirm impact and ETA in the next update. — Emily"

mike-sre: After restart errors dropped ~60% on cache-service metrics, but tail latencies still show a residual 5xx for long-context (> 4k tokens) paths. Looks like KV replication lag on failover.

sara (oncall): Implementing traffic routing to fallback variant. Command to update route (canary):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/update \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","model":"redwood-small-qual","canary_percentage":50}'
```

Starting canary at 10% -> 50% if stable for 5m.

status-bot: Status page changed to "Mitigating — Traffic reroutes in progress, +20% reduction in errors observed". Public update posted: "We're mitigating an issue affecting Dedicated EU inference; some requests may experience errors. Engineers are routing traffic to fallback models and restarting cache backends. Further updates every 20 minutes."

emily-cs: Sending tailored notices now. Will echo copy here for audit.

jordan-ps: Routed paging/contacts: P1 escalation list includes oncall pager (sara), primary SRE (mike-sre), customer leads (claire-nova, marc.a, laura.m). Phone tree initiated for NovaGrid.

diane-legal: Approving wording for NovaGrid/AlderBio/Meridian messages. Good to go.

ryan-eng: Long-term root cause: redis failover + sticky session keys on certain model contexts. Postmortem notes to include: improve redis readiness probe and make KV lookups resilient to transient misses.

sara (oncall): Handing off active monitoring to mike-sre for the next 2 hours. I'll update on-call log and incident runbook: "Handoff: Sara -> Mike. Steps completed: cache-01 restart, canary routing applied (50%), status page live, customer notices sent."

mike-sre: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep 10m alert cadence and report at :clock10: 09:40 UTC. If errors decrease to baseline for 15m, begin scaled rollback of canary.

emily-cs: Copy of the three sent customer notices attached to ticket INC-1789012345 (internal). I'll coordinate follow-ups and post final customer impact summary once resolved.

status-bot: Next public update scheduled in 20 minutes.

sara (oncall): Leaving minimal notes: incident severity=P2 (enterprise impact), active mitigations applied, handoff complete.

mike-sre: Will file immediate action items and start postmortem template after stabilization.

incident-bot: Incident channel archived to thread 1789012345 once resolved.
